findings.title: Application erases the real shared Tabs and repaints a second tab implementation
findings.evidence: Tabs::draw publishes the real component, then paint_capsule_tab_strip fills both rows and independently remeasures/paints daemon labels, prefixes, glyphs, active fill and rule. Its daemon-derived labels ignore capsule_tab_title used by build_capsule_tabs. Native tab_context_menu_renames_and_closes_by_mouse_and_keyboard passes on4cc and fails on262: rename ops commits but displayed row remains Mix/Shell/docs. Drawing and hit regions also have separate geometry owners.
findings.repair: Add borrowed tab content/parts and baseline layout/style policy to shared Tabs; use one semantic tab data/configuration source for update/draw. Remove application correction painter only after rename, close, overflow, pointer, resize and frozen paired checks pass.

findings.title: Scenario-selected input owner is no longer drawn, and ordinary typing disappears
findings.evidence: historical_capsule_frame depends on CapsuleMulti/Paused/state; new reserve_input excludes TextInput in that path, while update_capsule still handles CAPSULE_INPUT and buffers text there. New end-of-update focus redirects to selection-only TextViewport. Independent identical Paper121x41 probes: before rendered input and hello visible2/2; after0/2. Frozen capsule forward_key immediately sends Char/Backspace/Enter to pane instead of a second input buffer.
findings.repair: Make real pane terminal component own focus, typing, paste, selection and cursor; forward typed actions to application-owned domain source. Use one layout independent of scenario/test clock. Do not restore hidden control or add a non-reference input row.

findings.title: Default TextViewport changes its layout and silently adds a nonfunctional horizontal scrollbar
findings.evidence: All unwrapped callers now conditionally change text width by vertical overflow and reserve one row for horizontal overflow. Existing the_text_width_does_not_depend_on_whether_the_bar_is_painted passes before and fails after23vs22. paint_h_bar creates a fresh offset-zero ScrollState each draw and registers no horizontal interaction, so displayed scrollbar cannot reveal clipped text. No opt-in preserves existing default contract.
findings.repair: Keep existing default dimensions/overflow behavior; add explicit shared overflow policy and real horizontal state, input, hit regions and resolved-layout facts where required by terminal consumers. Verify all existing viewport callers and policy boundaries.

findings.title: MenuBar title patch now colors padding under the default title-only policy
findings.evidence: New padded string is painted at full rect instead of title-shifted label rect. Existing default_menu_bar_scope_keeps_title_patches_off_the_padding_cells: beforePASS, afterFAIL. Full Overlays125/125before;124pass1failafter,0skip.
findings.repair: Preserve label-only painting for default title scope; any full-title-padding styling needs an explicit shared opt-in contract. Coordinate with the current MenuReason writer; do not replace unrelated menu behavior.

findings.title: New span/color projection introduces unreadable monochrome text
findings.evidence: Existing historical_failure_and_action_labels_remain_readable_in_mono passes before and fails after at10789 with foreground Black equal background Black. The change preserves domain tones via projection, including raw success/error RGB overrides, but does not validate supported profile contrast. Exact failing tone/glyph was not separately isolated; do not assume all raw roles are responsible.
findings.repair: Diagnose failing projected role and resolve through shared semantic theme/profile rules, keeping baseline-specific appearance as documented generic variant if needed. Preserve span data in the application, not per-cell repair painters. Re-run both themes and all four profiles.

findings.title: Gutterless drawing and pointer mapping disagree by one column
findings.evidence: reserve_gutter(false) draws at area.x, but pos_at always subtracts area.x+1. External real runtime probe with aa bb: visible b atx3, clickx3 yields no selection because mapping hits preceding space; expected bb selection CellPos(0,3)..(0,5).
findings.repair: Resolve and reuse exact text rectangle for drawing, pointer mapping, clipping and cursor; do not patch pointer coordinates in Jackin.

findings.title: Public scroll_gap accepts values that panic during layout
findings.evidence: scroll_gap(u16::MAX) causes attempt to add with overflow atviewport.rs956 in unchanged public-consumer runtime probe. Both1+gutter+gap and1+gap use unchecked u16 addition before saturating subtraction.
findings.repair: Normalize/clamp configuration or use saturating arithmetic consistently; add zero/narrow/u16::MAX measurement, update and draw coverage.

findings.title: Every redraw now scans all text, bypassing warm layout cache and work accounting
findings.evidence: widest_line iterates every line and line_cols scans graphemes before layout cache lookup, even when wrap=true. Existing incremental work probes only count indexed/visible rows, so they do not account for the new O(total content) work. Static source finding; no performance benchmark claimed.
findings.repair: Use generation-aware cached intrinsic width, append/suffix invalidation, and skip horizontal-width work when disabled/wrapped. Extend work probe to cover width scanning with large warm data.

findings.title: Unfocused pane caret requests introduce runtime cursor rejection
findings.evidence: capsule_viewport now unconditionally enables caret_when_unfocused(true) for every pane. Existing every_named_scenario_renders_a_deterministic_frame passes before; after fails onoutro-last with CursorRejected ownerjackin.capsule Num(1)layer0. This exposes unresolved active-pane/layer cursor ownership; no specific low-level cursor fix is inferred solely from the diagnostic.
findings.repair: Only the actually active rendered terminal owner should publish cursor state through shared layer rules; preserve frozen visibility/position/shape and test modal/outro transitions. Never register an undrawn cursor owner.

Tabs owner exposes semantic prefix/label/suffix/selected rule slots; Jackin composes the real component without repaint, retaining rename data and shared hit geometry.
Shared status/meter/shell blocks replace new private layout/painters with explicit view data and generic policies; live data alone is insufficient architecture proof.
